import gc, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import ipaddress, planning
from common import validate

def build(nreq, per, qcap, noff, seed=9):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    leases = [{'id': 'L0', 'prefix': '2001:db8::/56', 'start': 0, 'end': 10**12 + 1,
               'subnets': list(range(16)), 'low_count': 32}]
    rq = [{'id': 'g0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': qcap}]
    for i in range(1, 32):
        rq.append({'id': 'g%d' % i, 'parent': 'g%d' % rnd.randrange(i), 'capacity': qcap})
    oq = [{'id': 'h0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': qcap}]
    for i in range(1, 32):
        oq.append({'id': 'h%d' % i, 'parent': 'h%d' % rnd.randrange(i), 'capacity': qcap})
    requests = []
    for i in range(nreq):
        addr = (0x20010db8 << 96) | ((i % 16) << 64) | (1 + (i // 16) % 32)
        requests.append({'id': 'r%05d' % i, 'at': 10, 'lease': 'L0',
                         'target': str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(addr)), 'service': 'tcp0',
                         'group': 'g%d' % rnd.randrange(32)})
    offers = []
    costs = rnd.sample(range(10**9), noff)
    for i in range(noff):
        listed = ['r%05d' % k for k in rnd.sample(range(nreq), per)]
        offers.append({'id': 'o%05d' % i, 'time': 20 + i, 'service': 'tcp0',
                       'prefix': '2001:db8::/32', 'capacity': rnd.choice([1, 2, 3]),
                       'cost': costs[i], 'group': 'h%d' % rnd.randrange(32), 'requests': listed})
    return {'version': 3, 'seed': 'sd', 'leases': leases, 'services': [{'id': 'tcp0', 'kind': 'tcp'}],
            'queries': [10], 'captures': [], 'requests': requests, 'offers': offers,
            'request_quotas': rq, 'offer_quotas': oq}

for label, nreq, per, noff, qcap, force in (
        ('small-own 3000x2 qcap2000', 3000, 2, 3000, 2000, 'ssp'),
        ('small-own 4096x2 qcap3000', 4096, 2, 4096, 3000, 'ssp'),
        ('nx same instance', 4096, 2, 4096, 3000, 'nx')):
    job = build(nreq, per, qcap, noff)
    ctx = validate(job)
    active = {r['id']: True for r in job['requests']}
    orig = planning.SMALL_PAIRS
    planning.SMALL_PAIRS = 10**9 if force == 'ssp' else -1
    gc.disable(); t = time.time()
    try:
        plan = planning.solve(ctx, active)
    finally:
        planning.SMALL_PAIRS = orig; gc.enable()
    print('%-28s pairs=%-7d resolved=%-5d cost=%-12d %.1fs' % (label, sum(len(o['requests']) for o in job['offers']),
          plan['resolved'], plan['cost'], time.time() - t))
